parameters.name: End
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The name of the namespace.

For more information about how to query the names of namespaces, see [DescribeHybridMonitorNamespaceList](~~428880~~).

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The statistical period of the monitoring data.

Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: PromSQL
parameters.description:
The metric name.

>  PromQL statements are supported.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description:
The start of the time range to query.

Unit: seconds.
